chunks: And it was narrated from ʿUbayd Allah al-Murāfiqī, who said:

I entered a bathhouse in al-Madīnah, and there was an elderly shaykh who was the caretaker of the bathhouse. So I said to him, “O shaykh, to whom does this bathhouse belong?” He said, “To Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام.” I said, “Did he used to enter it?” He said, “Yes.” I said, “How did he used to act?” He said, “He would enter and begin by applying depilatory paste to his pubic area and what was near it. Then he would wrap his waistcloth around the edges of his private part, and call me, so I would apply it to the rest of his body.”
One day I said to him, “What you would dislike that I see, I have already seen.” He said, “No indeed; the depilatory paste is a covering.”

key_terms.سُتْرَةٌ: a covering or means of concealment
key_terms.ٱلنُّورَةَ: depilatory paste used for hair removal

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام observe modesty in the bathhouse while using depilatory paste?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates the bathhouse practice of Imam Muhammad ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام, describing his manner of maintaining modesty while using depilatory paste. It highlights etiquette, bodily cleanliness, and the understanding that the paste itself functioned as a covering.
